summary: Spec fidelity [INFERENCE from the code, not executed]: plan_paging_1_2 writes an option out at its declared default as set_option(name, word_of(default)); the schema gives a repeatable option an array default (schema-doc: repeatable -> default array|null), and word_of turns an array into its JSON text, so one value '["a","b"]' is given instead of one occurrence per element. For an enum or integer repeatable option that is an invalid value, refused USAGE rather than CURSOR_INVALID, and L1.paging would fail cursor-bound-to-given-arguments for a conforming tool. No fake-tool option has an array default, so no test reaches it; canon at claim 1.2 has none either. Blast radius: a MUST row on any paged command with a repeatable option that has a list default and is not given by the paged invocation.
